title: eriophorum gracile var. coreanum
intro: Eriophorum gracile var. coreanum, commonly known as Corean cotton-grass, is a type of flowering plant in the sedge family, known for its white, feathery plumes that resemble cotton. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Corean cotton-grass include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
